Authors: put your book in front of my readers. I feature a small number of outside books here each month, every one personally reviewed by me before it runs, and every one labeled as what it is: a paid feature.

Paid feature

Website Feature

Paid feature

Website + Instagram

$75

Everything in Website Feature, plus one dedicated post on my Instagram presenting your book to my followers.

Paid feature

Full Spotlight

How it works: book your slot, send me your cover, blurb, and store link, and your feature is built within 5 business days. If your book is not a fit for my readers, your fee is refunded in full.

Questions before you book? Email mila.support@kingtransitionservice.com. A slot is only yours once checkout is complete: payment first, always.
